statement: theorem meanPredict_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ) (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ) (T : ℕ) : expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => meanPredict (fun i => Y i ω) t) T = (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ ω, (meanPredict (fun i => Y i ω) t - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧ 0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => meanPredict (fun i => Y i ω) t) T
